settings.keepWarm.subtitle: For Claude bots signed in with a subscription. Design from Cache Tax (MIT) by Karan Bansal.
settings.keepWarm.enable: Keep idle threads' prompt cache warm
settings.keepWarm.help: After a turn in a thread with at least 50k tokens of context, OpenMausBot sends one tool-less, forked request every 50 idle minutes so the next message re-reads the cache instead of re-writing the whole thread. Nothing appears in the chat. It stops at the end of the window, when a ping finds the cache already gone, at the spend limit or at the usage limit.
settings.keepWarm.cost: Each ping reads the thread's context at the cache-read rate and counts toward usage, spend limits and your plan's usage limit. API-key engines are never pinged: their cache lasts five minutes.

backup.scope: A password-protected backup of this installation: bots, conversations, instructions, local files, and non-secret settings. Drafts and preferences from this browser are included.
backup.excluded: Saved account credentials and connections are not included. Reconnect your accounts on a new machine; existing credentials on the destination stay unchanged. External CLI sign-ins and remote VM disks are not included.
backup.privacy: Chats, drafts, and user files are not automatically redacted and may contain pasted secrets. Keep this backup private and save its password safely; it cannot be recovered.
backup.passwordHint: Use a password of at least 12 characters. You will need it to import this backup.
backup.importHint: Choose an encrypted .ombbackup file and validate it before changing anything. Backups support up to 10 GB of installation data. Older team backups and shareable templates can still be imported from Templates.
backup.replaceWarning: This replaces everything in this installation; it does not merge. A recoverable safety backup of the current installation is kept before replacement. Restart is required.
backup.trustWarning: Only restore backups you trust: instructions, skills, and bot permissions are restored too. Reconnect accounts as needed. Routines, webhooks, and calendar calls arrive paused; pending work is not resumed.
backup.restart: The backup is ready to restore. Fully quit OpenMausBot and reopen it to finish. For a self-hosted server, restart the server process, then reload this browser. Do not just close this window.
backup.restartDesktop: Your backup is ready. Restart OpenMausBot to finish restoring it. Closing this window will not restart the server.
backup.restartFailed: Could not restart OpenMausBot. Fully quit the app and reopen it to finish restoring.
backup.recovering: Restoring this browser’s saved drafts and preferences…
backup.skipDraftsHint: Keep this browser’s current drafts and preferences. This does not undo the installation restore.
backup.serverBusy: An installation backup operation is already running.
companyBackup.title: Company cloud backups
companyBackup.managedScope: Your snapshots are available only to your signed-in company account, across your connected computers. Other members cannot restore them. Automatic backups are off unless you enable them.
companyBackup.managedEncryption: No backup password needed. Archives stay encrypted, with encryption keys protected by the backup service. This is service-managed encryption, not end-to-end encryption.
companyBackup.managedUploadWarning: Upload an encrypted copy of THIS installation to your {organization} account ({email})? It may contain personal conversations and files. Continue only if you want this installation stored there.
companyBackup.managedPrivacy: Chats, drafts, and user files are not automatically redacted and may contain pasted secrets. Only back up data you want stored with this service.
companyBackup.scheduleHelp: Once a day while this app's window is open. If this installation is busy, the backup waits; missed days are not replayed.
companyBackup.scheduleWarning: Automatically upload an encrypted copy of THIS installation to your {organization} account ({email}), starting in 24 hours. This includes future changes and may contain personal conversations and files. It does not create a separate installation for work.
companyBackup.schedulePassword: Your operating system encrypts the saved password. It never goes to Admin or browser storage. Keep a copy in your password manager for restores. Turning off daily backups or disconnecting removes the saved copy, not your cloud archives.
companyBackup.scheduleConsent: I want this installation, including future personal data it may contain, backed up to this company account every day.
companyBackup.scheduleFailed: The daily backup setting could not be saved. Unlock your system keychain and check your company connection, then try again.
companyBackup.savedSchedule: Daily company backups are paused until this computer reconnects to the same organization with the same account. Turn them off here to stop them.
companyBackup.scheduleStatus.waiting: On — waiting for the next backup.
companyBackup.scheduleStatus.paused: Waiting for this installation and the company connection to be ready.
companyBackup.scheduleStatus.error: The last attempt did not complete. Your existing backups are unchanged.
companyBackup.loadFailed: Cloud backups could not be loaded. Check your company connection, then refresh.
companyBackup.actionFailed: This backup operation could not complete. Check the password, available disk space, and company connection before trying again.
companyBackup.restoreFailed: The replacement could not be confirmed. Check local backup status before trying again; if a replacement is already staged, fully quit and reopen the app.
companyBackup.quota: {used} of {total} used or reserved · Up to {count} snapshots kept after a successful backup.
companyBackup.pending: {count} unfinished uploads or cleanups. Only completed, validated snapshots can be restored.
companyBackup.uploadWarning: This uploads an encrypted copy of THIS installation to your {organization} account ({email}). It may contain personal conversations and files. Continue only if you want this installation stored there. Keep the password yourself; it cannot be recovered and is never sent to your company administrator.
companyBackup.previewHelp: Download, check, and preview this encrypted backup first. This installation is not replaced until you review the preview and type REPLACE.
companyBackup.deleteWarning: Permanently delete only the cloud archive shown above. This installation and other snapshots stay unchanged. This cloud copy cannot be recovered.
